# package gsdml

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/gsdml"
```

Package gsdml reads, validates and writes GSDML (General Station Description Markup Language) files, the XML device descriptions of PROFINET IO devices, and converts between them and the device models of package model.

The document types (zz\_generated.go) are generated from the catalog schema/catalog.json by internal/cmd/gengsdml; SCHEMA.md lists what they model. Elements and attributes the catalog does not define are kept in the Unknown and Attrs fields and written back, so reading and writing a file does not lose information. Comments and the order of unknown elements among known ones are not preserved.

The official GSDML schemas are licensed by PROFIBUS & PROFINET International to its members and are not part of this package; Validate checks the structural and lexical rules of the catalog and the references between elements, which covers what the device model relies on. It is not a substitute for PI's GSDML checker.

## Constants

```go
const (
	// RuleStructure: required elements and attributes, lexical forms,
	// unique IDs (the catalog).
	RuleStructure = "structure"
	// RuleReference: every ID and text reference resolves (the catalog).
	RuleReference = "reference"
	// RuleUnknown: an element or attribute outside the catalog.
	RuleUnknown = "unknown"
	// RuleSchemaVersion: the document declares a schema version newer
	// than the catalog's.
	RuleSchemaVersion = "schema-version"
	// RuleIODataLength: the input or the output data of a submodule and
	// its provider status do not fit the 1440 octets an RT frame carries
	// (a physical limit).
	RuleIODataLength = "io-data-length"
	// RuleSlots: a module is allowed, used or fixed in a slot the device
	// access point does not have (PhysicalSlots), used or fixed where it
	// is not allowed, or two modules are fixed in one slot (consistency of
	// the document's own declarations).
	RuleSlots = "slots"
	// RuleIdentNumber: two modules share a ModuleIdentNumber, so that a
	// controller cannot tell them apart (local heuristic).
	RuleIdentNumber = "ident-number"
	// RuleRecordIndex: a parameter record outside the user index range
	// 0x0000-0x7FFF (the range of record indexes a device defines).
	RuleRecordIndex = "record-index"
	// RuleSubslot: an interface or port submodule outside 0x8000-0x8FFF,
	// the subslots PROFINET reserves for them (as p-net and pnio-rs number
	// them; local heuristic).
	RuleSubslot = "subslot"
	// RuleReductionRatio: a reduction ratio that is not a power of two
	// from 1 to 512, the RT_CLASS_1 ratios (local heuristic).
	RuleReductionRatio = "reduction-ratio"
)
```

Rules of the issues. The catalog rules come from the independent catalog; the semantic rules each state their basis.

### func ToModel

```go
func ToModel(doc *Document, dapID string) (*model.Device, error)
```

ToModel converts the device access point dapID (the first one when empty) of a document into a device model: the DAP, the modules that are fixed or used in slots, and the other usable modules as the catalog.

### func Validate

```go
func Validate(doc *Document) error
```

Validate checks the document against the catalog's structural and lexical rules, checks that every ID is unique and every reference (module, submodule, value item, graphic, category and text references) resolves, and that no submodule's IO data exceed an RT frame. It returns nil or a \*ValidationError with the errors; Check reports the warnings and the unvalidated content as well.

## Types

### type Document

```go
type Document = ISO15745Profile
```

Document is a parsed GSDML file.

#### func FromModel

```go
func FromModel(m *model.Device, opts GenerateOptions) (*Document, error)
```

FromModel generates a GSDML document that describes a device model: the identity, the DAP with its interface and ports, every module type with its submodules' IO data and parameter records, and the plugged modules as fixed in their slots. The document declares conformance class A and RT\_CLASS\_1, the scope this module implements. The result passes Validate.

### type GenerateOptions

```go
type GenerateOptions struct {
	// MainFamily is the Family/MainFamily; empty means "I/O".
	MainFamily string
	// DNSCompatibleName is the default station name; empty derives it
	// from the type of station.
	DNSCompatibleName string
	// NetloadClass is declared in the CertificationInfo; empty means "I".
	// It is a declaration the device vendor must back with a netload
	// test; this library does not establish it.
	NetloadClass string
	// PNIOVersion is the declared PNIO_Version; empty means "V2.35".
	PNIOVersion string
	// SupervisorAR declares DeviceAccessSupported.
	SupervisorAR bool
}
```

GenerateOptions tune FromModel.

### type Severity

```go
type Severity int
```

Severity grades an issue of a GSDML document.

```go
const (
	// SeverityError: the document breaks a rule of the catalog (structure,
	// lexical form, references) or a physical limit; Validate fails.
	SeverityError Severity = iota
	// SeverityWarning: the document is valid for the catalog but probably
	// wrong; the rule says whether it is publicly substantiated or a local
	// heuristic of go-profinet.
	SeverityWarning
	// SeverityUnvalidated: content outside go-profinet's catalog (newer
	// schema versions, vendor extensions); kept as read, not checked.
	SeverityUnvalidated
)
```
